question: Which five sheaths are proclaimed together with Ajapā and Mātṛkā?
premises: Ajapā and Mātṛkā are named in the enumeration
The enumeration forms a set of five
inference: Ajapā and Mātṛkā are included among the five proclaimed sheaths.
uncertainties: The identity of the remaining three sheaths is not specified in this verse
plain_english: Ajapā, Mātṛkā, and so on are declared to be the five sheaths.
